market_view: VIX calm at 16 but the 10-year yield sits at a 5.26% high with hike talk; a cooler core PCE (3.0%) lifted pre-market futures. Oil fell 3.5% on the last day and gold and uranium are weak.

oil_gas.reasoning: WTI -3.5% on the day is a driver move already priced. No XOM, OPEC+ or supply headline; the only energy items are generic Zacks momentum pieces (Petrobras, PBF). No named catalyst.

gold_miners.reasoning: Gold is -6.7% in 20 days with yields at highs and a firm dollar. The cooler core PCE is a macro item, not a NEM headline, and likely priced pre-open. Do not guess a rebound.

chips.catalyst: none qualifying: Motley Fool 'Cathie Wood Goes Bargain Hunting' mentions an Nvidia $150B buyback, but it was announced before today and is already priced
chips.reasoning: NVDA is 3.6% below its high after a strong semi rebound. The buyback is old news and the other headlines are generic. No fresh guidance or export-rule item.

pharma.reasoning: No LLY trial, regulator or pricing headline. The IOVA and URGN items are small-cap names, not the leader. Defensive and low volatility, but no reason to prefer long.

copper_uranium.reasoning: Copper -3.2% in 5 days, FCX -4.8%, uranium ETF weak. The UEC earnings call is a uranium peer item without a clear one-sided read for FCX. No China-data or supply headline.

would_change_my_mind: A named company or policy headline: XOM, OPEC+ or Hormuz news; NVDA guidance or an export-rule change; an LLY trial or pricing item; a copper supply outage or China data; or a NEM guidance change.

handoff.what_changed: Five days since the 09-25 note. WTI fell 3.5% on 09-29 to 89.4 and the 10-year yield rose to 5.26%, another high. Core PCE came in at 3.0% and futures opened higher, but headlines show no named catalyst on XOM, NEM, NVDA, LLY or FCX, so all five families stay flat.

oil_gas.why: WTI drop is priced in and there is no XOM, OPEC+ or Hormuz headline.

gold_miners.why: Yields at a high, firm dollar, gold -6.7% in 20 days, and no NEM headline.

chips.why: The NVDA $150B buyback is old news and priced in; no fresh guidance or export-rule item.

pharma.why: No LLY trial, regulator or pricing headline.

copper_uranium.why: Copper and uranium are weak and there is no FCX or China-data headline.
